purpose: Public contract for the core Moral Trade domain entities, required fields, privacy classes, relationship boundaries, and non-claims named by the product audit.

entities.label: Participant
entities.publicExposure: A participant appears publicly only through opted-in profile or offer preview fields.

entities.label: Public profile
entities.publicExposure: Shows broad previews and chosen visibility only; exact wishes, contact details, private source notes, and sensitive constraints stay out.

entities.label: Private wish profile
entities.publicExposure: Never public by default; fields can be summarized only through broad previews or explicit privacy grants.

entities.label: Profile visibility control
entities.publicExposure: Publishes only the selected visibility level, not the hidden profile fields behind it.

entities.label: Source connection
entities.publicExposure: Stores consent scope, import mode, and manual summaries only; raw private feeds are not ingested or searched.

entities.label: Source note
entities.publicExposure: Only coarse source summaries may be disclosed through a valid purpose-bound grant; raw notes remain private.

entities.label: Background wish interview session
entities.publicExposure: Stores deterministic clarification state for the participant only; it does not publish exact wishes, contact details, private answer text, or live public-preview changes.

entities.label: Background wish interview answer
entities.publicExposure: Answer text remains private and encrypted; analytics and match cards receive field keys, option counts, and length buckets rather than exact wishes or source notes.

entities.label: Background wish dialogue session
entities.publicExposure: Stores private fluent-composer workflow state only; natural-language wish text is encrypted in messages, exact wishes stay out of public previews, and matching cannot change until a proposal is explicitly applied.

entities.label: Background wish dialogue message
entities.publicExposure: Message bodies are encrypted private inputs for schema-bound proposals; analytics, public previews, and notifications never receive raw dialogue text or exact wishes.

entities.label: Background wish field proposal
entities.publicExposure: Stores schema-bound broad field proposals and uncertainty flags only; exact wishes, contact details, raw notes, and protected-trait inferences are rejected before apply.

entities.label: Reviewed background source summary
entities.publicExposure: Stores only a reviewed summary with raw ingestion disabled; raw private feeds, exact requests, contacts, and source notes stay out of public previews and analytics.

entities.label: Background source sync job
entities.publicExposure: Queues reviewed-summary sync work for a viewer-owned source connection; raw private feeds and source payloads are not stored, and revocation cancels queued or retrying jobs.

entities.label: Background profile signal
entities.publicExposure: Derived signals are viewer-owned matching inputs and expose only broad field keys or counts; revoked, expired, or stale source notes stop influencing matching.

entities.label: Saved search
entities.publicExposure: Search terms, offer browse filters, and notification choices remain viewer-owned; public search returns broad previews only.

entities.label: Trade format
entities.publicExposure: A public taxonomy for pledge swaps, donation offsets, paid actions, and public-good commitments.

entities.label: Offer
entities.publicExposure: Public offers expose only reviewed or preview-safe terms and must not imply escrow, legal enforceability, tax treatment, or objective moral endorsement.

entities.label: Baseline statement
entities.publicExposure: The no-trade baseline is reviewable and challengeable; sensitive details can be summarized or redacted.

entities.label: Evidence claim
entities.publicExposure: Claims disclose only scoped summaries and confidence; artifacts and private locators stay behind review controls.

entities.label: Opportunity-constrained meal evidence bundle
entities.publicExposure: Private meal-context evidence for optional pledge-swap verification. Public reports may expose only coarse reviewed meal-context use and must suppress cafeteria names, schedules, witness names, relationship details, raw testimony, and private context.

entities.label: Meal witness testimonial
entities.publicExposure: Private baseline, co-diner/direct-observer, or schedule-constraint testimony. Raw basis text, witness identity, relationship details, venue names, pressure reports, and side-payment concerns are never shown to funders or public reports.

entities.label: Opportunity constraint assessment
entities.publicExposure: Reviewer-scoped scorecard for meal-context evidence. Material use can affect verification confidence or additionality only through the frozen policy and cannot retroactively reduce fixed consideration.

entities.label: Artifact
entities.publicExposure: Artifacts require hashes, scope alignment, and redaction levels before any public reasoning summary references them.

entities.label: External entity reference
entities.publicExposure: External charities, payment providers, registries, or supplier-like records expose only stable redacted identifiers after registry or reviewer confirmation.

entities.label: Traceability event
entities.publicExposure: What/where/why event records include explicit what happened, who touched it, and when answers for payment, charity-routing, or external-evidence audits; raw artifacts and private provider payloads remain redacted.

entities.label: Provenance activity
entities.publicExposure: Activities link submitted, reviewed, and changed records to agents; public summaries omit raw private wishes, contact details, and source notes.

entities.label: Provenance agent
entities.publicExposure: Participants, counterparties, reviewers, operators, and providers are represented by scoped agent records; public labels require explicit redaction review.

entities.label: State transition event record
entities.publicExposure: Reliance-bearing status changes require immutable event hashes, agent links, and explicit what happened, who touched it, and when answers; public exposure is limited to redacted status evidence.

entities.label: Reviewer decision
entities.publicExposure: Only a narrow public reasoning summary is exposed when safe; private notes and source notes are redacted.

entities.label: Challenge
entities.publicExposure: Challenges target specific claims, evidence rows, baselines, disclosure decisions, or policy flags.

entities.label: Appeal
entities.publicExposure: Appeals do not reopen unrelated moral disagreements and cannot resolve disputes without human review.

entities.label: Dispute
entities.publicExposure: Dispute status may be public; private evidence and affected-party details remain review-scoped.

entities.label: Privacy grant
entities.publicExposure: Field-level, purpose-bound, stage-bound grants disclose only approved fields and never mutate from public contract reads.

entities.label: Match suggestion
entities.publicExposure: Uses broad previews, privacy policy ids, disclosure stages, and factor codes; exact wishes, source notes, and contact details stay hidden until consent.

entities.label: Background opportunity brief
entities.publicExposure: Shows a participant-owned broad card with factor codes and hidden-field notices; exact wishes, private asks, contact details, and source notes stay in the dashboard until consent.

entities.label: Background helper run
entities.publicExposure: Stores queued helper work and a hashed query fingerprint only; helper runs may prepare opportunity briefs and generic notifications but cannot send autonomous outreach.

entities.label: Background match feedback
entities.publicExposure: Stores closed-code relevance feedback and report reasons for private operations; public transparency uses only thresholded counts and generic labels.

entities.label: Background intro packet
entities.publicExposure: Captures a reviewed next-step request and never sends autonomous outreach or contact details; exact private fields require operator review and consent grants.

entities.label: Background private overlap tag
entities.publicExposure: Stores blinded exact-tag tokens only; raw tags, canonical tags, free text, exact wishes, and contact details are forbidden.

entities.label: Background private overlap check
entities.publicExposure: Records only a bucketed overlap result and receipt id after governance gates; public exposure is redacted, and raw matching tags or counterparty tag sets are never exposed.

entities.label: Transparency receipt
entities.publicExposure: Participant-visible append-only receipt metadata uses redacted payloads and hash chaining; exact wishes, source notes, contact details, and raw tags are excluded.

entities.label: Match concierge request
entities.publicExposure: Operator review queue records stay review-scoped; public reporting exposes only aggregate appeal, decline, review-time, and SLA counts without notes, contacts, or private source details.

entities.label: Notification
entities.publicExposure: Notification copy remains generic and omits exact wishes, contact details, source notes, and sensitive constraints.

entities.label: Payment record
entities.publicExposure: Records can reference provider events but do not claim escrow, custody, tax, investment, or legal advice.

entities.label: Payment update
entities.publicExposure: Status updates are evidence inputs, not automatic reviewed completion or custody guarantees.

entities.label: Agreement event
entities.publicExposure: Immutable event records support auditability; public summaries are redacted and status-scoped.

privacyClasses.rule: Validator metadata, taxonomies, and route contracts can be public.
Broad opted-in profile fields can be public without exact wishes, contacts, private source notes, or sensitive constraints.
Search and match previews must suppress sparse or sensitive result sets and return broad fields only.
Offer visibility depends on review status and redaction checks.
Viewer-owned private records require authentication and must not be exposed through public route contracts.
Identity and ownership records require authenticated viewer context.
Evidence, baseline, challenge, appeal, dispute, and reviewer records are visible only to allowed review contexts or redacted summaries.
Field-level disclosures require owner approval, purpose, audience stage, access level, expiry, and counterparty scope.
Notifications, payment references, and provider updates are private operating records with redacted public summaries only.

relationshipBoundaries.rule: Public profiles link to private wish profiles only through redacted previews, saved searches, match suggestions, or explicit privacy grants.
Source connections and source notes store consent scope, import mode, and manual summaries; raw private feeds are not mined, trained on, or exposed.
Match suggestions can cite broad factor codes, but exact wishes, source notes, contacts, and private query text require staged disclosure grants.
Reviewer decisions, challenges, appeals, disputes, payment updates, and agreement events cannot produce reliance states without human review and provenance activity.
Payment records and updates are external references and evidence inputs; they are not custody, escrow, legal, tax, or investment claims.

nonClaims: The data model does not create objective platform moral rankings.
The data model does not authorize autonomous outreach or surprise disclosure.
The data model does not ingest, scrape, mine, train on, or expose raw private feeds.
The data model does not treat payment references as escrow, custody, tax, legal, or investment advice.
The data model does not make reviewed completion durable without scoped evidence, human review, and provenance events.
